Castle Weddings
Welcome to Peckforton Castle
Peckforton Castle is the only intact medieval-style castle in England; a Grade I listed building which offers an exceptional setting for fairytale weddings, private celebrations, corporate events, and refined dining. Accommodation is available with 48 individually appointed bedrooms, plus secluded group accommodation with hot tubs ideal for private groups or pre-wedding celebrations.
Its striking architecture, classic interiors, and expansive grounds create a timeless sense of grandeur. You may have spotted our unique venue featured in films and television productions.
The castle offers a year-round programme of immersive ticketed events and the Land Rover Experience, as well as an award-winning fine dining 1851 Restaurant open to both residents and non-residents.
You’re invited to experience Peckforton Castle, where we look forward to welcoming you.
20th Anniversary of Peckforton Castle Celebrations
Fairytale Castle Wedding in Cheshire
Weddings at Peckforton Castle
If you’ve always dreamed of a castle wedding, there’s simply no setting more divine than Peckforton Castle. Discover the perfect place to hold your special day, a stunning venue steeped in romance, history and breathtaking beauty just waiting to play host to the start of your new beginnings.
The perfect setting for your fairytale castle wedding in cheshire. This Grade I-listed wedding venue in Cheshire combines historical grandeur with modern luxury.

Stay in a Historic Castle
Discover the magic of a genuine castle stay in the UK at Peckforton Castle, one of England’s most authentic castle hotels. Nestled in the stunning Cheshire countryside of North West England, our Victorian Gothic fortress offers an extraordinary escape where history, luxury, and romance combine to create an unforgettable castle accommodation experience.
Castle Stay UK
Peckforton Castle - Loved by Couples for 20 Years
20 Years of the Naylor Era
20 th June 2006 marked the beginning of a new chapter in the story of Peckforton Castle the Naylor family invested into the Castle to provide a dream destination for weddings, fine dining and overnight stays.
We invite you to look back on an extraordinary journey of love, resilience, and transformation. From the family’s own wedding at the Castle back in 2005, to the Castle becoming one of the UK’s most iconic wedding and hospitality destinations by 2026 hosting thousands of happy couples enjoying their own fairytale weddings.
20th Anniversary Celebrations
Grade 1 listed heritage
History meets modernity
In 1952, the Castle was recognised and rewarded by English Heritage when it was granted Grade I-listed status; as a building of exceptional interest and importance. As such, we are often faced with the task of preserving the castle’s original features whilst also continuing to be an accessible venue to everyone. Here are some the ways we’re continuing to be an inclusive business:
Bedroom access – available upon request, we have a number of bedrooms which can be accessed via a lift. We also have two ground floor rooms, one of which is a family and disabled access room.
Bag drop – we ask for all vehicles to be parked in the on-site car park. We allow bag-drop outside reception to avoid guests carrying baggage from the car park, and we are able to offer valet parking if required. There are 2 unmarked disabled spaces by our chapel (please ensure you display a blue badge when parking here)
Chair lifts – With the castle being a Grade 1 listed building, we are unable to build lifts to all areas of the castle. Therefore, where possible we have installed chair lifts throughout the building.

Don't make love wait
Wedding dates at Peckforton are often booked up well in advance but that doesn’t mean to say that weddings can’t be arranged at short notice.
Whether you’re looking for a grand celebration or an intimate renewal of your vows, we’re here to help you make it happen…without delay!
Last Minute Weddings
Every now and again we offer significant, one-time-only savings on late dates. Peckforton Castle and our team of expert wedding coordinators are always on hand to help create your dream wedding and help put the last minute plans together with you.

Dare to dream
Then wake in grandeur
Discover the magic of a genuine castle stay in the UK at Peckforton Castle, one of England s most authentic castle hotels. Nestled in the stunning Cheshire countryside of North West England, our Victorian Gothic fortress offers an extraordinary escape where history, luxury, and romance combine to create an unforgettable castle accommodation experience.
Unlike many UK castle hotels that are simply grand country houses, Peckforton Castle is a true fortress complete with towers, turrets, battlements, and a drawbridge. Built in 1851 by architect Anthony Salvin for MP John Tollemache, our castle was designed to authentically recreate a medieval stronghold while incorporating Victorian comfort and grandeur.
History meets modernity
Authentic Castle Architecture
When you stay at Peckforton Castle, you re not just booking a hotel room with castle theming. You re experiencing genuine castle living within walls that soar skyward, beneath vaulted stone ceilings, and through corridors lined with suits of armour. Every corner reveals architectural details that transport you back centuries: stone spiral staircases, Gothic arched windows, ornate fireplaces, and commanding views across the Cheshire Plain.
Our 48-acre estate includes woodland walks, formal gardens, and elevated positions that offer panoramic views stretching to the Welsh mountains on clear days. This is castle accommodation as it was meant to be experienced.

A Virtual Tour of Peckforton Castle
Frequently Asked Questions
Is Peckforton Castle a real castle or just a castle hotel?
Peckforton Castle is an authentic Victorian castle built in 1851 to recreate a medieval fortress. While it now operates as a luxury hotel, it features genuine castle architecture including towers, battlements, and a drawbridge.
Can you explore the castle during your stay?
Yes, guests are welcome to explore the castle s public areas, grounds, and battlements. Our 48-acre estate offers woodland walks and spectacular views across Cheshire.
Is Peckforton Castle suitable for children?
Absolutely. Families love staying at our castle hotel. Children are fascinated by the authentic castle features, and we offer family rooms and connecting accommodations. The grounds provide safe space for exploration and play.
What's included in the room rate?
All castle stays include luxury accommodation, WiFi, parking, and access to the castle grounds. Breakfast and other dining options, plus other activities can be booked.
How far is the castle from Chester?
Peckforton Castle is approximately 20 minutes drive from Chester city centre, making it perfect for combining a castle stay with exploring this historic city.
Can you book the entire castle?
Yes, Peckforton Castle is available for exclusive use for weddings , corporate events, and large group celebrations. Contact us for details about making this UK castle hotel entirely yours.

Wait a million tales to be told
Within these walls
Peckforton Castle's History
A visit to the Castle starts as you pass through the gatehouse lodge and up the sprawling driveway. Pass through the surrounding woodland before entering via an open carriage way, protected by a stunning portcullis through which adventure awaits…
1840 - 1851
And so the story begins...
It was in 1840 that John Tollemache bought the land that would become the home of Peckforton Castle. 36,000 acres of sprawling green Cheshire countryside. The plot included the villages of Peckforton and Beeston, plus the rolling hills destined to house this grand project.
Tollemache dreamt of a palatial fortified home in the style of a medieval castle and so work commenced in 1842 and the castle’s story began. With the sheer magnitude of such an imposing build, it was not completed until 1851.
1890 - 1952
The Tollemache family legacy
In 1876, Tollemache was awarded a Lordship in recognition of his services to agriculture. Throughout his life he was married twice, father to an impressive 25 sons and one daughter until he passed away in 1890 at the ripe old age of 85.
Only 12 of his sons survived him. The last member of the Tollemache family to live in the castle was Lord Bentley; who left Peckforton in 1939 and took up residence in Eastbourne. During World War II, in Lord Bentley’s absence the Castle provided care and a safe home to disabled evacuee children.
Grade 1-listed heritage
1952 - 2001
In 1952, the Castle was recognised and rewarded by English Heritage when it was granted Grade I-listed status; as a building of exceptional interest and importance.
In the 1980s the castle welcomed new tenants hosting a private members club known as The Treasure Trap. Visitors would don medieval costumes for live action fantasy games and once again the incredible setting was at the heart of all the fun. In 1989 the castle was sold again, becoming a venue for business conferences and wedding receptions.
